name: Jeffrey
source:
Discover the world behind the myth of Jeff The Killer. Meet characters entangled in his story, each with secrets and motives of their own. 

Investigate Jeff’s relationships, uncover his family’s history, and learn the dark realities of his interactions with his victims.

[From [url=https://chispadev.itch.io/jeffrey]Itch.io[/url]]

探索杀手杰夫神话背后的世界。认识卷入他的故事中的人物，每个人都有自己的秘密和动机。

调查杰夫的人际关系，揭开他的家族历史，并了解他与受害者互动的黑暗现实。
